root_cause:
Step 1: 13 of 17 noise failures come from station ST3 on the night shift, all BRG-6204; the other 4 are spread over ST1 and ST2.
Step 2: a pattern tied to one station and one shift points to that line's setup or material rather than the design. ST3 night shift also has all 3 lubrication notes (low grease, dry spots).
Step 3: dry or under-greased bearings are noisy, so a greasing problem on ST3 at night explains both modes; a worn noise-test fixture would also show on day shifts, which it does not.
Step 4: check the grease dosing unit on ST3, the night-shift grease batch and the setup sheet.

- Test equipment: fixture B clamp (high) - repair.
